greeting: Gardener Cirrus on comms. Stage 3: The Sky Gardens. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Sky Sanctuary. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Study the new celestial ecosystem.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Study the new celestial ecosystem; Help the cloud-whales migrate; Balance the storm patterns. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Help restore the celestial ecosystem damaged in the remaking. Immediate move: Study the new celestial ecosystem.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: The Sky Gardens. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Nix7's Origin.
rumor: A cloud ferry arrived before it departed and still demanded full fare.
People keep repeating one clue from The Sky Gardens: 'Balance the storm patterns'.
A pigeon outranked three commanders here last week. Merit system is broken.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in Aetherreach is clear-sky math: low noise, high visibility, best scouting window.
dialog.time_noon: Noon stacks wind traffic and patrol traffic together. Plan your crossings.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk paints false horizons here. Verify every ledge before committing.
dialog.time_night: Night turns cloud light into mirages. Keep formation and call targets out loud.

party_reactions.kade: Gardener Cirrus sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Gardener Cirrus accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Gardener Cirrus talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
